concepts.title: What a Robot Is: Classification, Components, and Degrees of Freedom
concepts.summary: What counts as a robot, links, joints, actuators, sensors, and end effectors, classifying manipulators by their joints, and counting degrees of freedom.

concepts.title: Rotation Matrices and Rigid-Body Orientation
concepts.summary: Rotation matrices and their properties, composing rotations about fixed and moving frames, Euler and roll-pitch-yaw angles, and gimbal lock.

concepts.title: Homogeneous Transformations for Robot Poses
concepts.summary: The 4x4 homogeneous transform as a rigid-body pose, its composition along a kinematic chain, and its inverse, moving the graphics lesson's idea into robot frames.

concepts.title: Forward Kinematics of Serial Manipulators
concepts.summary: Forward kinematics as a product of link transforms, worked on planar two-link and three-link arms and checked numerically.

concepts.title: The Denavit-Hartenberg Convention
concepts.summary: The Denavit-Hartenberg parameters, assigning link frames step by step, building the table, and the difference between the classic and modified conventions.

concepts.title: Inverse Kinematics and Workspace
concepts.summary: Geometric and numerical inverse kinematics, multiple solutions, and reachable versus dexterous workspace.

concepts.title: Velocity Kinematics and the Jacobian

related.label: Partial Derivatives and the Multivariable Chain Rule

concepts.summary: Linear and angular velocity of the end effector, building the geometric Jacobian from the chain, and how it differs from the analytic Jacobian.

concepts.title: Singularities and Manipulability
concepts.summary: Where the Jacobian loses rank, what a singularity does to joint velocities, and Yoshikawa's manipulability measure.

concepts.title: Static Forces and Joint Torques
concepts.summary: How the transpose of the Jacobian maps an end-effector force to joint torques, worked numerically on a serial arm.

concepts.title: Lagrangian Dynamics of an Open-Chain Robot
concepts.summary: Kinetic and potential energy of the links, the Euler-Lagrange equation, and deriving the dynamics of a two-link arm.

concepts.title: The Manipulator Equation: Inertia, Coriolis, Gravity
concepts.summary: The standard form of the manipulator equation, what its inertia, Coriolis, centrifugal, and gravity terms mean physically, and how they are computed for a two-link arm.

concepts.title: Independent Joint Control and PID
concepts.summary: Independent joint control of a geared motor, the P, I, and D terms and their tuning, gravity feed-forward, and what the decoupled approach ignores.

concepts.title: Trajectory Planning in Joint Space
concepts.summary: Joint-space trajectories with cubic and quintic polynomials, trapezoidal velocity profiles, and via points.

concepts.title: Robot Programming: Teach Pendants, Offline Languages, and ROS 2
concepts.summary: Teach pendants and offline languages as the book describes them, then the ROS 2 model of nodes, topics, services, and actions as practiced today.

concepts.title: Capstone: Tracing a Pick-and-Place Through Kinematics, Dynamics, and Control
concepts.summary: One pick-and-place task traced through the whole discipline: poses, inverse kinematics, a joint-space trajectory, the torques it demands, and the control loop that tracks it.
